title: Marketing and Operations Analyst
description: Job role We are looking for a Operations and Growth Analyst who will support the organization across reviewing business operations, team performance analytics, MIS reporting, QMS records and process improvement to drive business towards growth. The role requires an analytical and detail-oriented individual who can work with business data, coordinate with multiple teams, maintain operational records, monitor KPIs, identify gaps, and support management in improving business processes. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets, dashboards, trackers, documentation, and cross-functional teams and should have a strong ownership mindset. Roles & Responsibilities Monitor and coordinate day-to-day business and operational activities across different functions and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and action items. Prepare and maintain MIS reports, dashboards, trackers, and management reports related to business operations, team performance, finance, and QMS. Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze data from Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Quality, Product, and other functions to provide accurate and timely operational insights. Track team-wise and individual KPIs , targets, productivity, task completion, utilization, and performance against defined goals, and highlight gaps to the respective HOD/management. Support the management team in weekly/monthly business performance reviews by preparing data, reports, presentations, and action trackers. Maintain and monitor QMS documentation, SOPs, records, forms, revision history, audit-related documents, CAPA trackers, and compliance records in coordination with the Quality team. Support preparation for internal and external audits by coordinating required documents, records, evidence, and action-item follow-ups. Track QMS observations, CAPAs, corrective actions, and compliance activities and follow up with responsible team members for timely closure. Prepare Quotations/PIs /Invoices and coordinate with the stakeholders for invoices, payments, receivables, expenses, vendor/customer records, reconciliations, and other business-related financial trackers . Maintain accurate business and finance-related data and identify discrepancies or missing information for correction. Monitor operational expenses, pending payments, receivables, and other assigned financial/business metrics and provide regular updates. Identify process gaps, delays, duplication, inefficiencies, and operational risks and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution. Develop and improve Excel/Google Sheets-based trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems to improve visibility and accountability. Support process automation and digitization of repetitive operational and reporting activities. Maintain action trackers from management/HOD meetings and follow up with respective owners until closure. Coordinate with different departments to ensure timely completion of cross-functional activities and escalate critical delays. Support management in data-driven decision-making by providing accurate analysis, trends, and operational insights. Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of business, employee, financial, customer, and operational information. Perform other business operations and analytical activities assigned by management. Qualifications 0–2 years of experience in Business Operations, Business Analysis, Operations, MIS, Quality, Finance Operations, or a similar role. B.E./B.Tech/MBA candidates preferred , especially candidates with an analytical or engineering mindset. Freshers with strong Excel, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills may also be considered. Candidates who demonstrate career stability, ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to work across functions will be preferred. Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Food provided Health insurance Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition)
description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Analyst (Data Strategy & Acquisition) Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions Hyderabad / Chennai At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s What Makes Us Roche. As a Senior Data Strategy & Acquisition Analyst within GATE, you will be a recognized subject-matter expert on the U.S. healthcare data landscape. You will go beyond responding to requests — you will proactively scout, evaluate, and unlock new data assets that expand what Roche's U.S. commercial organization can see and act on. You will operate as a genuine thought partner to U.S. brand, market access, forecasting, field operations, and advanced analytics teams across multiple therapeutic areas, shaping decisions on multi-million-dollar data investments. The Opportunity Multi-Facet Data Asset Portfolio: Own the evaluation, acquisition, and lifecycle management of a broad and diverse portfolio of U.S. healthcare data assets — claims, EHR/EMR and clinical real-world data, specialty pharmacy and hub data, lab and biomarker/genomic testing data, payer and formulary intelligence, sales and distribution, provider reference and affiliation data, patient-level longitudinal data, and competitive/market intelligence Proactive Data Scouting & Market Sensing: Continuously track the evolving U.S. data vendor and RWD market — new entrants, emerging and innovative asset types, consolidation, and pricing/licensing trends. Bring forward unsolicited recommendations on datasets Roche should consider and on new use cases that existing assets could unlock Therapeutic Area Partnership: Partner with stakeholders across Oncology, Ophthalmology, Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic (CVRM), Neurology, Immunology and Rare Disease, translating each TA's distinct commercial questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements — recognizing that a retina franchise, a solid-tumor biomarker-driven brand, and a cardiometabolic primary-care brand each demand fundamentally different data strategies Vendor Evaluation & Head-to-Head Benchmarking: Evaluate new and incumbent vendors (eg:-IQVIA, Komodo Health, Clarivate/DRG, MMIT, Optum, Truveta, Flatiron, Verana ), on methodology, capture and coverage, patient/provider linkage, recency and lag, known biases, limitations, and fit-for-purpose. Design and run structured bake-offs and overlap analyses rather than relying on vendor claims External Partnerships: Act as the primary technical counterpart to external data vendors — interrogating source methodologies, resolving data quality queries, influencing roadmap and enhancement requests, and supporting renewal and expansion discussions with an evidence-backed point of view Data Profiling & Risk Assessment: Perform hands-on profiling, cross-source comparison, and validation. Quantify gaps, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback to ensure alignment with business objectives and realistic expectations of what the data can and cannot support Who You Are Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Bioinformatics, Public Health, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, healthcare data strategy, life sciences consulting, or a healthcare data vendor. Prior experience in a Data acquisition, Data strategy, Data governance, or RWD-evaluation function is strongly preferred. Multi-Facet Data Asset Exposure (core requirement): You have worked hands-on across several of the following and can speak credibly to the strengths, biases, and limitations of each: Claims: open vs. closed, medical vs. pharmacy, submits vs. remits, switch/clearinghouse vs. payer-sourced (IQVIA LAAD/Dx/PharMetrics, Komodo, Clarivate), patient-lives coverage, payer mix, rejection/denial and reversal analytics EHR/EMR and clinical RWD: structured vs. unstructured content, clinical depth (stage, biomarkers, labs, performance status, laterality), health-system coverage bias, ambulatory vs. inpatient capture, and the NPI/provider-identifier limitations of EHR sources Data Linkage: tokenization and patient-level linkage across claims, EHR, lab, and specialty pharmacy assets (e.g., Datavant), and the practical pitfalls of doing so Specialty pharmacy, hub, and distribution data; buy-and-bill dynamics Lab, diagnostic, and biomarker/genomic testing data Payer, formulary, and market access intelligence (MMIT, DRG Fingertip, Policy Reporter), including coverage policy, utilization management, and GTN-relevant inputs Provider reference and affiliation data (NPI/DEA, IQVIA OneKey, IDN/GPO and health-system hierarchies), and how it powers HCP/account targeting Competitive and market intelligence (Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group) Emerging/innovative assets: ambient and digital health data, registries, SDOH, imaging, patient-reported and adherence data Therapeutic Area Exposure: Demonstrated exposure to either of Oncology (solid tumor and/or heme; biomarker testing, staging, lines of therapy, pathways), Ophthalmology (Imaging and registry data such as IRIS/Verana), or CVRM (cardiovascular, metabolic and obesity, lab-value-driven segmentation such as HbA1c/LDL/eGFR, high-volume PCP targeting). Rare disease, neurology, or immunology exposure is a strong plus. Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning and structured problem-solving with meticulous attention to detail. You engage stakeholders consultatively, ask the sharp clarifying question before proposing a solution, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations and "so what?" insights Technical Skills : Proficient in SQL or similar technology for independent extraction, profiling, and validation on large patient-level datasets. Comfortable in creating a visualizations in any industry wide known platforms. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
